title: TPP Part-Class Parameters
description: Tool Path Planning parameters for a part class. Required sections must be present; feature sections are activated by their activate flag.

tpp_sanding_behaviour.title: Sanding Behaviour
tpp_sanding_behaviour.description: Core sanding entry/exit and boundary offset settings. All fields are compulsory.

turn_on_sander_above_part.title: Turn On Sander Above Part
turn_on_sander_above_part.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

If true, the sander is turned on while the tool is above the part (approach phase), not just during contact.

outer_boundary_subtraction.title: Outer Boundary Subtraction
outer_boundary_subtraction.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.005` | **Unit**: meters

Distance to subtract from the outer boundary when computing the sanding region. 

For concave boundaries, recommendation is to keep this value same as `inner_boundary_subtraction` due to algorithm design.

inner_boundary_subtraction.title: Inner Boundary Subtraction
inner_boundary_subtraction.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.005` | **Unit**: meters

Distance to subtract from the inner boundary when computing the sanding region. 

For concave boundaries, recommendation is to keep this value same as `outer_boundary_subtraction` due to algorithm design.

entry_exit_offset.title: Entry/Exit Offset
entry_exit_offset.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.1` | **Unit**: meters

Retraction distance for entry/exit paths above the part surface.

entry_exit_inclination_angle.title: Entry/Exit Inclination Angle
entry_exit_inclination_angle.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.0` | **Unit**: degrees

Scalar form: single angle applied to all entry/exit paths.

Vector form: `[[primary_tilt, secondary_tilt], ...]` — Multiple options to improve chances of reachability success. Priority order is determined by the order in the list.

[→ Documentation](https://github.com/GrayMatter-Robotics/platform/tree/main/src/planners/tool_path_planner/docs/EntryExitInclination.md)

tpp_planning_parameters.title: Planning Parameters
tpp_planning_parameters.description: Core path planning parameters. Most fields are compulsory; smoothening and repeat_reachable_pts_analysis are optional.

pathgap_sanding_line.title: Pathgap Sanding Line
pathgap_sanding_line.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.01` | **Unit**: meters

Point spacing along sanding lines.

pathgap_connection_line.title: Pathgap Connection Line
pathgap_connection_line.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.01` | **Unit**: meters

Point spacing along connection lines

pathgap_entry_exit_line.title: Pathgap Entry/Exit Line
pathgap_entry_exit_line.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.01` | **Unit**: meters

Point spacing along entry/exit retraction paths.

continuity_distance.title: Continuity Distance
continuity_distance.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.06` | **Unit**: meters

Maximum gap between consecutive points before a jump is inserted.

boundary_detection_dist.title: Boundary Detection Distance
boundary_detection_dist.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.03` | **Unit**: meters

A sanding line is split wherever consecutive points are more than this distance apart (e.g. across a hole or gap in the surface).

cnt_sanding_line.title: CNT Sanding Line
cnt_sanding_line.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `90` | **Range**: 1–100

Fanuc CNT (approximate motion) value for sanding line segments.

cnt_connection_line.title: CNT Connection Line
cnt_connection_line.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `90` | **Range**: 1–100

Fanuc CNT value for connection line segments.

cnt_start_end_line.title: CNT Start/End Line
cnt_start_end_line.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `95` | **Range**: 1–100

Fanuc CNT value for start/end (entry/exit) line segments.

cnt_boundary_sanding_line.title: CNT Boundary Sanding Line
cnt_boundary_sanding_line.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `90` | **Range**: 1–100

Fanuc CNT value for boundary sanding line segments.

remove_unreachable_pts_radius_multiplier.title: Remove Unreachable Pts Radius Multiplier
remove_unreachable_pts_radius_multiplier.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `4`

Multiplier applied to `pathgap_connection_line` to compute the exclusion radius around unreachable path points. 

Increase to remove more points around unreachable areas and coverge on a plan faster. Decrease to keep more points and potentially find a plan where others fail, at the risk of longer planning time.

acceptable_sanding_path_length.title: Acceptable Sanding Path Length
acceptable_sanding_path_length.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.2` | **Unit**: meters

Minimum path length for a sanding segment to be retained (shorter segments are discarded).

acceptable_dist_2_next_line_percentage.title: Acceptable Distance to Next Line Percentage
acceptable_dist_2_next_line_percentage.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `600`

Maximum allowable connection distance expressed as `(100 + value)%` of the stepover distance (distance between consecutive sanding lines). 

E.g. 600 means 700% of stepover distance. 

 Negative = Infinite distance. 

Increase or make negative to allow connections between lines that are farther apart.

normal_estimation_radius.title: Normal Estimation Radius
normal_estimation_radius.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.01` | **Unit**: meters

Neighbourhood radius for estimating surface normals at each grid point.

z_estimation_radius.title: Z Estimation Radius
z_estimation_radius.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.02` | **Unit**: meters

Neighbourhood radius for estimating Z height at each grid point.

acceptable_neighbours_in_radius.title: Acceptable Neighbours in Radius
acceptable_neighbours_in_radius.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `3`

Minimum number of neighbours required within the normal estimation radius for a point to be considered valid.

remove_pts_outside_boundary.title: Remove Points Outside Boundary
remove_pts_outside_boundary.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

When true, points outside the detected boundary are removed. Requires `feature_radius_boundary_estimation`.

feature_radius_boundary_estimation.title: Feature Radius Boundary Estimation
feature_radius_boundary_estimation.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.03` | **Unit**: meters

**Compulsory when `remove_pts_outside_boundary: true`.**
Radius used to compute the boundary during outside-boundary point removal.

smoothening_repeat.title: Smoothening Repeat
smoothening_repeat.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0`

Number of path smoothing passes. `0` = disabled. When > 0, `path_smoothing_weight` is compulsory.

path_smoothing_weight.title: Path Smoothing Weight
path_smoothing_weight.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.05`

**Compulsory when `smoothening_repeat > 0`.**
Weight factor for path smoothing (higher = more smoothing).

repeat_reachable_pts_analysis.title: Repeat Reachable Points Analysis
repeat_reachable_pts_analysis.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `5`

Number of times to repeat the reachability analysis pass. Increase to potentially reduce number of jumps at the cost of longer planning time.

tpp_boundary.title: Boundary Configuration
tpp_boundary.description: Boundary offset and optional boundary pass coordinator/clip settings.

offset_to_actual_boundary.title: Offset to Actual Boundary
offset_to_actual_boundary.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.0` | **Unit**: meters

Offset applied to shrink the detected boundary before planning.

outer_boundary_pass_coordinator_cloud.title: Outer Boundary Pass Coordinator Cloud
outer_boundary_pass_coordinator_cloud.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class (feature opt-in) | **Default**: `false`

Activates boundary pass planning using the pre-segmentation cloud. When true, all `outer_boundary_pass_*` sub-parameters are compulsory.

[→ Documentation](https://github.com/GrayMatter-Robotics/platform/tree/main/src/planners/tool_path_planner/docs/OuterBoundaryPass.md)

allow_inner_boundary_pass_coordinator_cl.title: Allow Inner Boundary Pass Coordinator Cloud
allow_inner_boundary_pass_coordinator_cl.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

**Compulsory when `outer_boundary_pass_coordinator_cloud: true`.**
If true, generates paths for both inner and outer boundaries.

use_stitched_tpp_input.title: Use Stitched TPP Input
use_stitched_tpp_input.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

**Compulsory when `outer_boundary_pass_coordinator_cloud: true`.**
If true, uses the stitched segmented clouds; if false, uses the pre-segmentation cloud.

coordinator_cloud_cluster_tolerance.title: Coordinator Cloud Cluster Tolerance
coordinator_cloud_cluster_tolerance.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.03` | **Unit**: meters

**Compulsory when `outer_boundary_pass_coordinator_cloud: true`.**
Clustering tolerance for the pre-segmentation cloud (used when multiple parts are present).

outer_boundary_pass_pcl_boundary_radius.title: Outer Boundary Pass PCL Boundary Radius

outer_boundary_pass_pcl_boundary_cluster.title: Outer Boundary Pass PCL Boundary Cluster Tolerance

outer_boundary_pass_tpp_boundary_search_.title: Outer Boundary Pass TPP Boundary Search Radius

clip_boundary_path.title: Clip Boundary Path
clip_boundary_path.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class (feature opt-in) | **Default**: `false`

When true, clips boundary paths of length `clip_boundary_path_distance` from the start and end points.

tpp_tool_characteristic.title: Tool Characteristic
tpp_tool_characteristic.description: Tool geometry parameters. All fields are compulsory.

tool_contact_width.title: Tool Contact Width
tool_contact_width.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.155` | **Unit**: meters

Contact diameter (orbital sander) or width of the tool that touches the surface.

thin_features_subtraction.title: Thin Features Subtraction
thin_features_subtraction.markdownDescription: **Feature opt-in** — set `activate: true` to enable. All sub-parameters become compulsory when activated.

activate.title: Activate Thin Features Subtraction
activate.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

Enables thin feature subtraction. When true, all other fields in this section are compulsory.

subtraction_value.title: Subtraction Value
subtraction_value.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `0.0` | **Unit**: meters

Amount to subtract for thin features.

inner_outer_boundary_cluster_tolerance.title: Inner/Outer Boundary Cluster Tolerance
inner_outer_boundary_cluster_tolerance.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `0.01` | **Unit**: meters

Tolerance to differentiate between inner and outer boundaries.

consider_inside_boundary.title: Consider Inside Boundary
consider_inside_boundary.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `true`

If true, searches for disconnected inner boundaries.

feature_size.title: Feature Size
feature_size.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `0.0` | **Unit**: meters

Thickness of the thin feature (used by algorithm 2).

preserve_corners.title: Preserve Corners
preserve_corners.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `true`

If true, corner geometry is preserved during thin feature subtraction.

tpp_ZigZag_pattern.title: ZigZag Pattern
tpp_ZigZag_pattern.markdownDescription: **Feature opt-in** — set `activate: true` to enable. `amplitude` is compulsory when activated.

activate.title: Activate ZigZag Pattern
activate.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

Enables zigzag sanding pattern. When true, `amplitude` is compulsory.

amplitude.title: ZigZag Amplitude
amplitude.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `0.05` | **Unit**: meters

Peak-to-centre amplitude of the zigzag pattern.

multiTCP.title: Multi-TCP
multiTCP.markdownDescription:
**Feature opt-in** — set `activate: true` to enable multi-TCP planning. `activate_single_tcp_collision_check` works independently.

Nested feature: `is_sandblasting: true` requires its own set of sub-parameters.

[→ Documentation](https://github.com/GrayMatter-Robotics/platform/tree/main/src/planners/tool_path_planner/docs/MultiTCPUpdates.md)

activate.title: Activate Multi-TCP
activate.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

Enables multi-TCP planning. When true, all compulsory sub-parameters must be present.

activate_single_tcp_collision_check.title: Activate Single-TCP Collision Check
activate_single_tcp_collision_check.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class (optional) | **Default**: `false`

Removes points potentially in collision with the pre-segmentation cloud during single-TCP planning. Works independently of `activate`.

rot_shift_angles_allAx.title: Rotation Shift Angles (All Axes)
rot_shift_angles_allAx.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when `activate: true`** | **Default**: `[[15,0,0],[0,15,0],[-15,0,0],[0,-15,0]]` | **Unit**: degrees

List of `[x, y, z]` rotation shift angle vectors. Each inner array must have exactly 3 elements.

trans_shift_angles.title: Translation Shift Angles
trans_shift_angles.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when `activate: true`** | **Default**: `[0, 90, 180, 270]` | **Unit**: degrees

Angles at which translational TCP shifts are attempted.

offset_radius.title: Offset Radius
offset_radius.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when `activate: true`** | **Default**: `0.06` | **Unit**: meters

Radius of the translational TCP offset circle.

collision_radius.title: Collision Radius
collision_radius.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when `activate: true`** | **Default**: `0.08` | **Unit**: meters

Radius of the swept cylinder used for collision detection in multi-TCP planning.

height.title: Height
height.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when `activate: true`** | **Default**: `1`

Height parameter for multi-TCP swept cylinder check.

surface_offset.title: Surface Offset
surface_offset.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when `activate: true`** | **Default**: `0.004` | **Unit**: meters

Height offset from the surface used for the swept cylinder in multi-TCP collision detection.

trans_rot_only.title: Translation + Rotation Only
trans_rot_only.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when `activate: true`** | **Default**: `false`

If true, only combined translation+rotation TCPs are used.

trans_only.title: Translation Only
trans_only.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when `activate: true`** | **Default**: `false`

If true, only translational TCPs are used.

prefer_trans_only.title: Prefer Translation Only
prefer_trans_only.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when `activate: true`** | **Default**: `false`

If true, translational TCPs are preferred over rotational ones.

separate_mTCP_paths.title: Separate Multi-TCP Paths
separate_mTCP_paths.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when `activate: true`** | **Default**: `false`

If true, generates separate paths per TCP.

skip_center_tcp_swptcyl_check.title: Skip Center TCP Swept Cylinder Check
skip_center_tcp_swptcyl_check.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Optional when `activate: true`** | **Default**: `false`

Skips the swept cylinder collision check for the centre TCP. Useful when applying z-axis tool rotations.

is_sandblasting.title: Is Sandblasting
is_sandblasting.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Optional when `activate: true`** | **Default**: `false`

Enables sandblasting mode. When true, sandblasting sub-parameters are compulsory.

allow_free_space_blasting.title: Allow Free Space Blasting
allow_free_space_blasting.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when `is_sandblasting: true`** | **Default**: `true`

Allows the tool to blast the free space.

prefer_non_free_space_blasting.title: Prefer Non-Free-Space Blasting
prefer_non_free_space_blasting.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when `is_sandblasting: true`** | **Default**: `true`

Prefers pointing towards the surface over free space when both are feasible.

do_not_blast_red_pts.title: Do Not Blast Red Points
do_not_blast_red_pts.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when `is_sandblasting: true`** | **Default**: `true`

Skips blasting at points marked red (unreachable/restricted).

raytrace_cluster_tolerance.title: Raytrace Cluster Tolerance
raytrace_cluster_tolerance.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when `is_sandblasting: true`** | **Default**: `0.01` | **Unit**: meters

Clustering tolerance used during raytrace-based blasting analysis.

tpp_variable_pathgap.title: Variable Pathgap
tpp_variable_pathgap.markdownDescription: **Feature opt-in** — set `activate: true`. `target_norm_change` and `gap_range` are compulsory when activated.

activate.title: Activate Variable Pathgap
activate.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

Enables adaptive pathgap based on surface curvature.

target_norm_change.title: Target Normal Change
target_norm_change.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `0.687`

Target cos(angle) between consecutive surface normals. `cos(46.7°) ≈ 0.687`.

gap_range.title: Gap Range
gap_range.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `[0.004, 0.03]` | **Unit**: meters

`[min_gap, max_gap]` — the pathgap adapts between these values. Preferably multiples of the grid length.

tpp_contact_analysis.title: Contact Analysis
tpp_contact_analysis.markdownDescription: **Scope**: part-class (optional) — no activate flag; all parameters are independently optional.

auto_calculate_radius.title: Auto Calculate Radius
auto_calculate_radius.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

If true, calculates the tool radius as half the sanding line spacing (changes with overlap percentage).

backing_pad_height.title: Backing Pad Height
backing_pad_height.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.025` | **Unit**: meters

Height of the backing pad used in pad coverage calculation.

force_calc_radius_step_percent.title: Force Calc Radius Step Percent
force_calc_radius_step_percent.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `10` | **Unit**: percent

Step size (as a percentage of radius) used in pad coverage calculation iterations.

force_calc_angle_step.title: Force Calc Angle Step
force_calc_angle_step.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `10` | **Unit**: degrees

Angular step size used in pad coverage calculation iterations.

write_all_files.title: Write All Files
write_all_files.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

If true, writes all intermediate contact analysis files to disk.

boundary_normal_retention.title: Boundary Normal Retention
boundary_normal_retention.markdownDescription: **Feature opt-in** — set `activate: true`. All sub-parameters are compulsory when activated.

activate.title: Activate Boundary Normal Retention
activate.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

Retains surface normals at the boundary region.

boundary_width.title: Boundary Width
boundary_width.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `0.035` | **Unit**: meters

Width of the boundary zone where normals are retained.

refine_normals_neighbours.title: Refine Normals Neighbours
refine_normals_neighbours.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `0`

Number of neighbours used for normal refinement. `0` = no refinement.

removeBottomPoints.title: Remove Bottom Points
removeBottomPoints.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `false`

If true, removes points at the bottom of the part based on reference_pt geometry.

reference_pt.title: Reference Point
reference_pt.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `[1.02, -0.15, 0.41]` | **Unit**: meters

`[x, y, z]` reference point for bottom-point removal geometry.

plusY_angle.title: +Y Angle
plusY_angle.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `60` | **Unit**: degrees

Angle threshold in the +Y direction for bottom-point removal.

negY_angle.title: -Y Angle
negY_angle.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `60` | **Unit**: degrees

Angle threshold in the -Y direction for bottom-point removal.

midpass_SPC_near_boundary.title: Mid-Pass SPC Near Boundary
midpass_SPC_near_boundary.markdownDescription: **Feature opt-in** — set `activate: true`. `dist_from_boundary` and `min_sanding_distance` are compulsory when activated. Part-class based — each part class controls independently.

activate.title: Activate Mid-Pass SPC Near Boundary
activate.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

Enables sandpaper changing (SPC) near boundary in the middle of a pass.

dist_from_boundary.title: Distance from Boundary
dist_from_boundary.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `0.03` | **Unit**: meters

Distance from boundary within which SPC is applied.

min_sanding_distance.title: Minimum Sanding Distance
min_sanding_distance.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `0.3` | **Unit**: meters

Minimum total sanding path length required before SPC is applied.

midpass_SPC_anywhere.title: Mid-Pass SPC Anywhere
midpass_SPC_anywhere.markdownDescription: **Feature opt-in** — set `activate: true`. `small_length_to_ignore` is compulsory when activated.

activate.title: Activate Mid-Pass SPC Anywhere
activate.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

Enables sandpaper changing (SPC) insertions anywhere in the mid-pass.

small_length_to_ignore.title: Small Length to Ignore
small_length_to_ignore.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `0.0` | **Unit**: meters

Sanding segments shorter than this value are skipped for SPC insertion.

ramp_force_entryexit.title: Force Ramp — Entry/Exit
ramp_force_entryexit.markdownDescription:
**Feature opt-in** — set `activate: true`. All sub-parameters are compulsory when activated.

Ramp styles: `instant` | `linear` | `power` | `inverse_power`

[→ Documentation](https://github.com/GrayMatter-Robotics/platform/tree/main/src/planners/tool_path_planner/docs/ProcessPropertiesModulation.md)

entry_start_value_multiplier.title: Entry Start Value Multiplier
entry_start_value_multiplier.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `0.2`

Force multiplier at the start of the entry ramp (relative to nominal).

entry_delay_length.title: Entry Delay Length
entry_delay_length.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `-0.2` | **Unit**: meters

Distance before the surface at which the entry ramp starts. Negative = starts before contact.

entry_ramp_dist.title: Entry Ramp Distance
entry_ramp_dist.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `0.4` | **Unit**: meters

Length of the entry ramp.

entry_ramp_style.title: Entry Ramp Style
entry_ramp_style.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `inverse_power`

Profile shape of the entry ramp.

exit_end_value_multiplier.title: Exit End Value Multiplier
exit_end_value_multiplier.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `2`

Force multiplier at the end of the exit ramp.

ramp_style_power.title: Ramp Style Power
ramp_style_power.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `2`

Exponent used when ramp style is `power` or `inverse_power`.

ramp_force_nearconnection.title: Force Ramp — Near Connection
ramp_force_nearconnection.markdownDescription:
**Feature opt-in** — set `activate: true`. All sub-parameters are compulsory when activated.

[→ Documentation](https://github.com/GrayMatter-Robotics/platform/tree/main/src/planners/tool_path_planner/docs/ProcessPropertiesModulation.md)

connection_value_multiplier.title: Connection Value Multiplier
connection_value_multiplier.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `0.3`

Force multiplier applied at the connection point.

ramp_rpm_entryexit.title: RPM Ramp — Entry/Exit
ramp_rpm_entryexit.markdownDescription:
**Feature opt-in** — set `activate: true`. All sub-parameters are compulsory when activated.

[→ Documentation](https://github.com/GrayMatter-Robotics/platform/tree/main/src/planners/tool_path_planner/docs/ProcessPropertiesModulation.md)

ramp_rpm_nearconnection.title: RPM Ramp — Near Connection
ramp_rpm_nearconnection.markdownDescription:
**Feature opt-in** — set `activate: true`. All sub-parameters are compulsory when activated.

[→ Documentation](https://github.com/GrayMatter-Robotics/platform/tree/main/src/planners/tool_path_planner/docs/ProcessPropertiesModulation.md)

ramp_cnt_entryexit.title: CNT Ramp — Entry/Exit
ramp_cnt_entryexit.markdownDescription:
**Feature opt-in** — set `activate: true`. All sub-parameters are compulsory when activated.

[→ Documentation](https://github.com/GrayMatter-Robotics/platform/tree/main/src/planners/tool_path_planner/docs/ProcessPropertiesModulation.md)

ramp_cnt_nearconnection.title: CNT Ramp — Near Connection
ramp_cnt_nearconnection.markdownDescription:
**Feature opt-in** — set `activate: true`. All sub-parameters are compulsory when activated.

[→ Documentation](https://github.com/GrayMatter-Robotics/platform/tree/main/src/planners/tool_path_planner/docs/ProcessPropertiesModulation.md)

boundary_dist_based_force.title: Boundary Distance-Based Force
boundary_dist_based_force.markdownDescription:
**Feature opt-in** — set `activate: true`. `force_range` and `distance_range` are compulsory when activated.

Interpolates force within `force_range` based on the point's distance to the boundary, within the zone defined by `distance_range`.

distance_range.title: Distance Range
distance_range.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `[0.1, 0.3]` | **Unit**: meters

`[min_dist, max_dist]` from boundary.

boundary_dist_based_rpm.title: Boundary Distance-Based RPM
boundary_dist_based_rpm.markdownDescription:
**Feature opt-in** — set `activate: true`. `rpm_range` and `distance_range` are compulsory when activated.

Interpolates RPM within `rpm_range` based on the point's distance to the boundary, within the zone defined by `distance_range`.

distance_range.title: Distance Range
distance_range.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `[0.04, 0.3]` | **Unit**: meters

`[min_dist, max_dist]` from boundary.

tpp_advanced_planning_params.title: Advanced Planning Parameters
tpp_advanced_planning_params.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class (optional)

Advanced tool, path, and planning configuration. Embedded features: `shape_following_path` and `keep_shifting_start_pts_around_corners`.

**Note**: `parallel_planning`, `parallel_planning_batch_size`, `max_reachability_requests`, `max_parallel_astar_requests`, and `record_surface_normal_frame` are **global-only** — set them in the system config file.

turn_off_tool.title: Turn Off Tool
turn_off_tool.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

If true, overrides all tool status to off (tool never activates).

delay_tool_start.title: Delay Tool Start
delay_tool_start.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0`

+ve = delay tool activation by N points after first touch; -ve = activate N points early.

delay_tool_end.title: Delay Tool End
delay_tool_end.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0`

+ve = delay tool deactivation by N points after last touch; -ve = deactivate N points early.

tilt_tcp_path_dir.title: Tilt TCP Path Direction
tilt_tcp_path_dir.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0` | **Unit**: degrees

Tilt about the axis pointing toward the next waypoint.

tilt_tcp_orth_dir.title: Tilt TCP Orthogonal Direction
tilt_tcp_orth_dir.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0` | **Unit**: degrees

Tilt about the axis orthogonal to the direction of travel.

tcp_offset.title: TCP Offset
tcp_offset.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.0` | **Unit**: meters

Radius offset on the sanding pad.

path_following_tilt.title: Path Following Tilt
path_following_tilt.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `true`

If true, the tool tilts to follow the path direction.

follow_path_TCP.title: Follow Path TCP
follow_path_TCP.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

If true, TCP orientation follows the path tangent.

entry_exit_inclination_angle_n_pts_avg_d.title: Entry/Exit Inclination Angle N-Pts Average Direction
entry_exit_inclination_angle_n_pts_avg_d.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `5`

Number of points over which to average the path direction for entry/exit inclination.

tcp_rotation_angle_0.title: TCP Rotation Angle 0 (z+ normal)
tcp_rotation_angle_0.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.0` | **Unit**: degrees

TCP rotation override for x-y plane, z+ surface normal.

tcp_rotation_angle_1.title: TCP Rotation Angle 1 (x- normal)
tcp_rotation_angle_1.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.0` | **Unit**: degrees

TCP rotation override for y-z plane, x- surface normal.

tcp_rotation_angle_2.title: TCP Rotation Angle 2 (y- normal)
tcp_rotation_angle_2.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `-90.0` | **Unit**: degrees

TCP rotation override for x-z plane, y- surface normal.

tcp_rotation_angle_3.title: TCP Rotation Angle 3 (x+ normal)
tcp_rotation_angle_3.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.0` | **Unit**: degrees

TCP rotation override for y-z plane, x+ surface normal.

tcp_rotation_angle_4.title: TCP Rotation Angle 4 (y+ normal)
tcp_rotation_angle_4.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `90.0` | **Unit**: degrees

TCP rotation override for x-z plane, y+ surface normal.

tcp_rotation_angle_5.title: TCP Rotation Angle 5 (z- normal)
tcp_rotation_angle_5.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.0` | **Unit**: degrees

TCP rotation override for x-y plane, z- surface normal.

do_not_connect_sanding_lines.title: Do Not Connect Sanding Lines
do_not_connect_sanding_lines.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

If true, sanding lines are not connected during planning (no connection segments generated i.e. pre-reachability).

remove_surface_connection_lines.title: Remove Surface Connection Lines
remove_surface_connection_lines.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

If true, removes connection lines from the planned surface path output (i.e. post-reachability).

[→ Documentation](https://github.com/GrayMatter-Robotics/platform/tree/main/src/planners/tool_path_planner/docs/RemoveSurfaceConnectionLines.md)

reorderBtwnSegments.title: Reorder Between Segments
reorderBtwnSegments.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

If false, sands one segment at a time. If true, reorders points across segments.

separate_by_seed_id.title: Separate by Seed ID
separate_by_seed_id.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

If true, separates output paths by seed ID.

separate_by_tcp_id.title: Separate by TCP ID
separate_by_tcp_id.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

If true, separates output paths by TCP ID.

projection_mode.title: Projection Mode
projection_mode.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `obb`

Method used to project fill points onto the surface.
- `obb` = Optimal Bounding Box
- `pca` = Principal Component Analysis
- `preset` = World-axis alignment

grid_addition.title: Grid Addition
grid_addition.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.0`

Additional offset added to the grid length.

pca_similarity_threshold_percent.title: PCA Similarity Threshold Percent
pca_similarity_threshold_percent.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `85.0` | **Unit**: percent

Threshold for considering PCA axes similar between segments.

pca_similarity_correction_angle.title: PCA Similarity Correction Angle
pca_similarity_correction_angle.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `45.0` | **Unit**: degrees

Correction angle applied when PCA axes are deemed similar.

outer_boundary_subtraction_x_dir.title: Outer Boundary Subtraction X Direction
outer_boundary_subtraction_x_dir.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.0` | **Unit**: meters

Directional offset for outer boundary subtraction along X (sanding line direction).

outer_boundary_subtraction_y_dir.title: Outer Boundary Subtraction Y Direction
outer_boundary_subtraction_y_dir.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.0` | **Unit**: meters

Directional offset for outer boundary subtraction along Y (perpendicular to sanding line direction).

retraction_lookAhead_dist.title: Retraction Look-Ahead Distance
retraction_lookAhead_dist.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.1` | **Unit**: meters

Distance ahead used to determine retraction points. The points within this look-ahead window are planned in parallel for reachability.

[→ Documentation](https://github.com/GrayMatter-Robotics/platform/tree/main/src/planners/tool_path_planner/docs/SkipRetractionTries.md)

retraction_check_skip_n_pts.title: Retraction Check Skip N Points
retraction_check_skip_n_pts.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `5`

Checks for retraction every N points.

[→ Documentation](https://github.com/GrayMatter-Robotics/platform/tree/main/src/planners/tool_path_planner/docs/SkipRetractionTries.md)

always_compute_seed_indices.title: Always Compute Seed Indices
always_compute_seed_indices.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

If true, the trajectory planner performs seed analysis on every planning call (more time, marginally fewer jumps).

sanity_check_relaxation_factor.title: Sanity Check Relaxation Factor
sanity_check_relaxation_factor.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `1.5`

Multiplier of `continuity_distance` used for sanity check threshold.

skip_n_trajectory_pts.title: Skip N Trajectory Points
skip_n_trajectory_pts.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0`

*Requires advance mode.* Skips N trajectory points in output.

z_height_offset_all_waypoints.title: Z Height Offset All Waypoints
z_height_offset_all_waypoints.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.0` | **Unit**: meters

Uniform Z offset applied to all waypoints.

world_x_offset.title: World X Offset
world_x_offset.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.0` | **Unit**: meters

Shifts the input pre-segmentation cloud along X.

world_y_offset.title: World Y Offset
world_y_offset.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.0` | **Unit**: meters

Shifts the input pre-segmentation cloud along Y.

world_z_offset.title: World Z Offset
world_z_offset.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `0.0` | **Unit**: meters

Shifts the input pre-segmentation cloud along Z.

boundary_est_is_omp_else_tbb.title: Boundary Estimation: OMP (else TBB)
boundary_est_is_omp_else_tbb.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

If true, uses OpenMP for boundary estimation; if false, uses TBB.

[→ Documentation](https://github.com/GrayMatter-Robotics/platform/tree/main/src/planners/tool_path_planner/docs/ParallelizedBoundaryEstimation.md)

fillpts_gen_is_omp_else_tbb.title: Fill Points Generation: OMP (else TBB)
fillpts_gen_is_omp_else_tbb.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

If true, uses OpenMP for fill point generation; if false, uses TBB.

[→ Documentation](https://github.com/GrayMatter-Robotics/platform/tree/main/src/planners/tool_path_planner/docs/FillptGenDualParOption.md)

override_surface_normals.title: Override Surface Normals
override_surface_normals.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

If true, overrides computed surface normals with alternative values.

shape_following_path.title: Shape Following Path
shape_following_path.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Feature flag** | **Default**: `false`

Enables centred path following for surface pass. When true, `offset_values_for_shape_following` and `threshold_for_ignoring_rows` are compulsory.

[→ Documentation](https://github.com/GrayMatter-Robotics/platform/tree/main/src/planners/tool_path_planner/docs/CenteredShapeFollowing.md)

offset_values_for_shape_following.title: Offset Values for Shape Following
offset_values_for_shape_following.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when `shape_following_path: true`** | **Default**: `[-0.02, 0.0, 0.02]` | **Unit**: meters

Offset distances from the centre line for parallel shape-following paths.

threshold_for_ignoring_rows.title: Threshold for Ignoring Rows
threshold_for_ignoring_rows.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when `shape_following_path: true`** | **Default**: `0.0`

Ignore fill-point rows shorter than `threshold × max_row_length` when generating the centre path.

keep_shifting_start_pts_around_corners.title: Keep Shifting Start Points Around Corners
keep_shifting_start_pts_around_corners.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Feature flag** | **Default**: `false`

When true, `extra_jumps_allowed_for_shifting_pts` is compulsory.

[→ Documentation](https://github.com/GrayMatter-Robotics/platform/tree/main/src/planners/tool_path_planner/docs/ShiftStartPoints.md)

extra_jumps_allowed_for_shifting_pts.title: Extra Jumps Allowed for Shifting Points
extra_jumps_allowed_for_shifting_pts.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when `keep_shifting_start_pts_around_corners: true`** | **Default**: `0`

Additional jumps allowed when shifting start points around corners.

beta_features.title: Beta Features
beta_features.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class — experimental features, each gated by its own boolean flag.

Activation: set the feature flag to `true`. Some features then require additional sub-parameters.

optimal_path_shift.title: Optimal Path Shift
optimal_path_shift.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Feature flag** | **Default**: `false`

When true, `good_major_proportion_start` and `good_major_proportion_end` are compulsory.

correct_obb_edge_case.title: Correct OBB Edge Case
correct_obb_edge_case.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Feature flag** | **Default**: `false`

When true, `obb_dot_threshold_for_correction` is compulsory.

obb_dot_threshold_for_correction.title: OBB Dot Threshold for Correction
obb_dot_threshold_for_correction.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when `correct_obb_edge_case: true`** | **Default**: `0.9` | **Range**: 0–1

Higher = more aggressive OBB edge correction.

boundary_pass_away_from_bbox.title: Boundary Pass Away from Bounding Box
boundary_pass_away_from_bbox.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Feature flag** | **Default**: `false`

When true, `distance_from_bbox` and `ignore_dimensions` are compulsory.

distance_from_bbox.title: Distance from Bounding Box
distance_from_bbox.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when `boundary_pass_away_from_bbox: true`** | **Default**: `0.02` | **Unit**: meters

Boundary pass points within this distance from the bounding box are removed.

ignore_dimensions.title: Ignore Dimensions
ignore_dimensions.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when `boundary_pass_away_from_bbox: true`** | **Default**: `[false, false, false]`

`[ignore_x, ignore_y, ignore_z]` — dimensions to ignore when computing distance to bounding box.

augment_surface_normals.title: Augment Surface Normals
augment_surface_normals.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Feature flag** | **Default**: `false`

When true, `min_length_proportion_percent_of_line` and `keep_lines_at_percent` are compulsory.

[→ Documentation](https://github.com/GrayMatter-Robotics/platform/tree/main/src/planners/tool_path_planner/docs/AugmentedSurfaceNormals2D.md)

min_length_proportion_percent_of_line.title: Min Length Proportion Percent of Line

keep_lines_at_percent.title: Keep Lines at Percent
keep_lines_at_percent.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when `augment_surface_normals: true`** | **Default**: `[0, 45, 100]`

1D form: `[pct, pct, ...]` — keep lines at these percentages of segment width.
2D form: `[[pct, ...], [pct, ...]]` — one list per pass (enables `edge_sanding_order`).

> **Note**: The 2D form requires RSW approval before deploying at a customer site.

edge_sanding_order.title: Edge Sanding Order
edge_sanding_order.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Optional when `keep_lines_at_percent` is 2D form**

`[[segment_id, pass_id], ...]` — defines the order in which edge sanding passes are executed.

try_to_skip_p2p.title: Try to Skip Point-to-Point
try_to_skip_p2p.markdownDescription:
**Feature opt-in** — set `activate: true`. `euclidean_distance_threshold`, `joint_angle_discontinuity_threshold`, and `extender_discontinuity_threshold` are compulsory when activated. `entry_exit_reduction_distance` is optional.

> **Note**: Requires RSW approval before deploying at a customer site.

[→ Documentation](https://github.com/GrayMatter-Robotics/platform/tree/main/src/planners/tool_path_planner/docs/TryToSkipP2P.md)

activate.title: Activate Skip P2P
activate.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `false`

When true, attempts to skip point-to-point moves where safe.

entry_exit_reduction_distance.title: Entry/Exit Reduction Distance
entry_exit_reduction_distance.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Optional when activated** | **Default**: `0.0` | **Unit**: meters

Reduces the entry/exit path length by this amount.

euclidean_distance_threshold.title: Euclidean Distance Threshold
euclidean_distance_threshold.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `0.03` | **Unit**: meters

Maximum Euclidean distance between corresponding sanding points for a skip to be attempted.

joint_angle_discontinuity_threshold.title: Joint Angle Discontinuity Threshold
joint_angle_discontinuity_threshold.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `0.5` | **Unit**: radians

Maximum joint angle discontinuity allowed when skipping P2P.

extender_discontinuity_threshold.title: Extender Discontinuity Threshold
extender_discontinuity_threshold.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Compulsory when activated** | **Default**: `0.1` | **Unit**: meters

Maximum extender axis discontinuity allowed when skipping P2P.

trajectory_planner.title: Trajectory Planner
trajectory_planner.markdownDescription: **Scope**: part-class — only `ori_options` belongs here. `reachability_service_attempts` is global-only.

ori_options.title: Orientation Options
ori_options.markdownDescription:
**Scope**: part-class | **Default**: `[false, false, false]`

`[x, y, z]` booleans controlling which axes the trajectory planner uses for orientation solving. If all false, the solver uses `solver_settings`.
